**STEP 1 - Scene:** An airline-style tray meal with several small components: sushi, a fresh spring roll, a fruit bowl, an oatmeal cookie, juice, pickled ginger and soy sauce.

**STEP 2 - Vessels:** Three paper plates of about 20 cm, one bowl of about 15 cm, and a juice glass. I treat all of them as one meal because they are on the same tray.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Sushi maki (4 pieces), fresh spring roll (2 rolls), mixed fruit (watermelon, strawberry, cantaloupe, apple), oatmeal cookie, orange juice, pickled ginger, soy sauce.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Food covers roughly 60% of the combined plate and bowl area. Sushi ~20%, spring roll ~20%, fruit ~15%, cookie ~5%. Juice, ginger and soy are small.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Not computed per item in detail; I estimated each item's volume from its apparent size.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Estimated from visible volume and bulk density. Sushi ~120 g, spring roll ~120 g, fruit ~180 g, cookie ~25 g, juice ~200 ml, ginger ~10 g, soy sauce ~10 g. Total ≈ 665 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Sushi ~170 kcal/100 g, spring roll ~110, fruit ~40, cookie ~470, juice ~45, ginger ~40, soy ~60.
- Sushi ≈ 200 kcal
- Spring roll ≈ 130 kcal
- Fruit ≈ 72 kcal
- Cookie ≈ 118 kcal
- Juice ≈ 90 kcal
- Ginger ≈ 4 kcal
- Soy ≈ 6 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 620 kcal and ≈ 665 g. That is plausible for a full tray-style meal with this much visible food. These are rough visual estimates.

**Estimate: about 665 g and about 620 kcal.**
